aiPanel.globalPromptPlaceholder: Background context for the whole project; optional
aiPanel.localPromptPlaceholder: Extra instructions applied to the current view only; optional
aiPanel.previewPlaceholder: Click "Generate Preview" or type content directly
aiPanel.sentencePlaceholder: Sentence result; edit it and use it as input for "Generate"
aiPanel.directEmpty: Preview is empty. Click "Generate Preview" or type content first
aiPanel.empty: No nodes in the current view

settings.aiConnectionDesc: Configure LLM connection parameters. Changes take effect immediately and are saved to the plugin config, not to project files
settings.aiBaseURLDesc: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; local Ollama defaults to http://localhost:11434/v1
settings.aiModelDesc: Must match a model name available on the endpoint, e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b
settings.aiApiKeyDesc: Optional; usually not needed for local Ollama
settings.aiShortcutsDesc: Shortcut actions registered by this plugin; click a keycap to rebind
settings.aiDirectionsDesc: Manage AI divergence directions and their default behavior
settings.directionPromptPlaceholder: Divergence instruction for this direction; may reference the divergence start with ${from}
settings.directionSeparatorHint: Separator used when merging multiple divergence starts; optional, defaults to a space.
settings.resetDirectionsConfirm: Reset to default divergence directions? Custom directions will be cleared and built-in defaults restored.
